statement: The entire global H-section fiber with first class 3 kappa_3(3) has explicit topological coordinates Z_3 times the restricted sequence module on primes p!=3 with ord_p(27) prime to three, times Z_3 times Z_3[[Z]]. The scaled toric image is exactly the completed rational Kummer classes supported on those primes and three, and every toric fiber is the explicitly computed compact group Z_3 times Z_3[[Z]]. The radical-field ordinary-unit norm limit and all surviving valuation chains are evaluated with actual maps.

notes: The actual Frobenius normalization is given by h=rho_0^((t^-1-1)/12), proving kappa_3(3)(tau)=1 and its conjugate value -1 while retaining the two Frattini generators.

Finite coefficients are compared with the full G_{K,{3}}: degree-one graph homomorphisms factor through the maximal pro-three quotient, and higher vanishing follows by the proved trivial-F_3 filtration. No unrelated pro-three cohomology comparison is assumed.
Every unramified class has a unique tau-value 3b_3+z eta+T^3 W f(W^2), with W=(T-T^-1)/2 and eta=1-(T^-1+T^-2)/2. The proof gives an integral continuous reduction algorithm and uniqueness.

The two radical towers F_n and L_n are explicitly factored, with degrees and total ramification proved by valuations. Their 3-primary class groups vanish; the strongly ambiguous formula proves actual unit norm surjectivity in the cyclic towers, and conjugation averaging proves completed unit norm surjectivity in the real-root tower.
The ordinary global-unit norm limit is exactly Z_3[[Z]], mapped by the actual unramified cocycle T^3 W f(W^2). The two three-prime valuations of the general normal form are (a+z,-z).

At p!=3 the invariant measure lattice is one Dirac line precisely when the affine Frobenius has an integral fixed point, equivalently ord_p(27) is prime to three. Intersecting with J gives the saturated lattice 3 Z_3 delta_x.

The unique fixed point corresponds to a compatible degree-one prime chain. All other norm valuations vanish from unbounded residue degrees. The restricted sequence condition is proved exactly from the finite coefficient-and-positional topology.
Both finite-coefficient localization with the Mittag-Leffler left term and an independent field-theoretic unit correction construction prove surjectivity of all allowed residue families.

The norm systems pi_p are constructed by completed principal divisors and actual surjective unit norms; the displayed product gives every class and specifies the coordinate dependence on those choices.
The theorem evaluates the target H of the exact intrinsic maps; it does not infer liftability through their recorded kernels.
Exact checks pass for 64 normal-form reductions, 22 arithmetic normalizations, 957 ideal norm transitions across 54 primes, and four radical field factorizations.
